content.text: The digital creator economy is a global phenomenon, but not every creator has access to the same tools. In regions like Nigeria, Ghana, and Kenya, where Stripe and PayPal are unavailable or restricted, digital creators face significant challenges in monetizing their work. This is not a problem of creativity or demand but of infrastructure. These creators need a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-trap-most-creators-3|payment]] infrastructure that is not only accessible but also designed to serve their unique needs.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-automated-digital-product-10. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Solana payment

COREMERCH is a sovereign commerce infrastructure company that provides a solution to this problem. We design, document, and deploy digital commerce stacks that enable creators to sell their digital products, from [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-sell-ebooks-kenya-step-step-deployment-guide-19|COREMERCH guide to ebooks]] to software, without relying on conventional payment platforms. Our stacks are complete combinations of free and paid tools, ensuring creators have a fully operational online store with automatic [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-first-principles-definitive-4|Crypto Payment]] payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. By focusing on infrastructure sovereignty, we empower creators to own their digital commerce destiny.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Our stacks leverage the power of decentralized technologies to bypass traditional payment barriers. We use hosting platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, which are free and globally accessible. For backend logic, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script provide the necessary automation without any cost. Order storage is handled by Supabase or Google Sheets, again at no expense. File delivery is automated through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, ensuring customers receive their purchases instantly. The key to our solution is NOWPayments, a crypto payment gateway that supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including Solana, with a minimal 0.5% fee and no KYC requirements. This architecture ensures creators can sell their digital products without being limited by geographical or platform restrictions.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is tailored for digital creators in regions where traditional payment platforms are unavailable or severely restricted. These creators, often in countries like Nigeria, Pakistan, Bangladesh, and Zimbabwe, have valuable digital products to sell but lack the necessary tools to reach a global market. By providing a comprehensive, low-cost solution, we enable these creators to bypass the limitations of conventional platforms and establish a direct connection with their customers. With COREMERCH, creators can focus on creating and selling, not on navigating payment platform bureaucracy.
COREMERCH empowers creators with infrastructure sovereignty, not platform dependency.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The success of our stacks lies in the seamless integration of various components. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages provide a reliable and scalable hosting foundation. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script automate critical backend processes, ensuring smooth order management and delivery. Supabase or Google Sheets store order data, allowing for efficient tracking and analytics. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 deliver digital products instantly upon purchase, enhancing the customer experience. NOWPayments acts as the linchpin, enabling crypto payments with low fees and instant transaction verification. This integrated ecosystem ensures a smooth and secure digital commerce experience for both creators and customers.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Deploying a sovereign digital commerce stack is now within reach for creators worldwide. Our products, like the Complete Builder Kit ($197), provide all the necessary blueprints and templates to build, deploy, and scale a digital store. With instant download access, creators can quickly set up their stack and start selling. The Complete Builder Kit includes everything from documentation to source code, ensuring creators have the knowledge and tools to succeed. By choosing COREMERCH, creators gain the freedom to sell their digital products on their terms, without platform restrictions or high fees.

Our stacks enable you to sell directly to customers, bypassing traditional payment platforms. With low fees, instant delivery, and full data ownership, you can focus on creating and selling, not on payment processing limitations.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack today, follow these steps: Choose a COREMERCH product like the Complete Builder Kit ($197) from our shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. Download the selected product, which includes all the necessary blueprints and templates. Set up your hosting on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, a free and accessible platform. Configure backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate order processing. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing, supporting various cryptocurrencies with low fees. Upload your digital products to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for instant delivery upon purchase. Test and deploy your stack, ensuring a seamless customer experience. Promote your digital store and start selling directly to customers worldwide.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I sell digital products without using Gumroad or Payhip?

Absolutely. COREMERCH provides an alternative infrastructure that allows you to sell digital products without relying on these platforms. Our stacks include everything you need to create your own digital store, from hosting to payment processing.
What are the benefits of using crypto payments for digital products?

Crypto payments offer several advantages. They bypass traditional payment platform restrictions, enabling global reach. With low fees, you keep more of your revenue. Crypto payments also provide instant transaction verification, ensuring a seamless customer experience. Additionally, you retain full data ownership, enhancing privacy and control.
How do I ensure my digital products are delivered securely and instantly?

COREMERCH stacks utilize Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for secure and instant file delivery. These services automatically provide customers with access to their purchases upon successful crypto payment verification. This automation ensures a smooth and efficient delivery process.
What if I need help setting up or scaling my digital commerce stack?

COREMERCH provides comprehensive documentation and source code with our products, ensuring you have the knowledge to deploy and manage your stack. We also offer support options, including 30-day support with some products, to assist you in setting up and scaling your digital commerce infrastructure.
How does COREMERCH ensure my data and payments are secure?

We prioritize security by leveraging the robust security features of the underlying infrastructure. Cloudflare, Google, and NOWPayments have industry-leading security practices, ensuring your data and payments are protected. Additionally, crypto payments provide an added layer of security and privacy, further safeguarding your transactions.
